name: Low-Rank Simplicial Profile of Antipodal Partial Cubes
statement: If an antipodal partial cube has rank three, then every $\Theta$-class contains an edge incident with a vertex of degree three; consequently its minimum degree is at most its rank. The same degree bound has been verified computationally for every antipodal partial cube of isometric dimension at most seven.
comments: The arbitrary-rank Las Vergnas-type bound remains open and is retained as prose in the survey.
